meta.policy: coreConflicts 与 minorPending 中的任何一项，系统不得静默解决：能双口径计算的展示两个结果；需要数值输入的要求 LO 手工输入；影响资格的显示 Manual Confirmation Required。内部 guideline 冲突一律不得出现在发给 borrower 的问题里。closedOrReclassified 仅作追溯记录，不参与判定。
meta.escalation: coreConflicts 中的 6 项即为需发送公司确认的问题（Production@gmccloan.com, cc mlaw@gmccloan.com），见 docs/company-questions-email.md。

coreConflicts.title: DTA 定义：subject 取值、扣减项与车辆取值基准（原 CONF-003/004 并入）

positions.text: Total assets = Zillow value on all REOs (subject to ownership %) + liquid & non-liquid funds (bank, stocks, retirement) after cash to close + FMV of other assets
positions.reading: REO 用 Zillow；扣 cash to close 全额

positions.text: Total assets: Subject property market value (per appraisal report) plus All verified assets ... minus Assets used to purchase subject property.
positions.reading: subject 用 appraisal；purchase 扣『用于购买 subject 的资产』；refi 不扣
示例：subject 用 purchase price；扣 down payment + closing cost

positions.text: 14. DTA ratio is based on purchase price or appraisal value – whichever is LOWER
positions.reading: 价值基准取低

positions.text: Auto loan is assumed to be offsetting asset/liability for DTA if value >loan balance and not used as non-liquid assets
positions.reading: 车辆按 offsetting asset/liability 处理（第 20 页示例把 20,000 同时计入两侧，与此一致）

coreConflicts.assessment: offsetting 做法本身两页一致，不再作为『计不计』的冲突。未决的是：(a) subject 取 appraisal、purchase price 还是取低；(b) 扣减项是 cash to close 全额还是仅 down payment + closing cost；(c) 车辆 offsetting asset 的取值按实际 FMV、按与贷款余额同额，还是其他规定值。
coreConflicts.companyQuestion: DTA 的 Total Assets：subject property 取值基准是什么？扣减项范围是什么？车辆 offsetting asset 应按实际 FMV、按贷款余额同额，还是其他规定值入表？

scenarios.label: 第 20 页示例口径：subject=purchase price，扣 down payment + closing cost，车辆两侧按贷款余额同额
第 21 页表格口径：subject=appraisal，purchase 扣用于购买 subject 的资产，车辆按 FMV/余额进两侧
第 12 页价值基准：subject 取 purchase price 与 appraisal 较低者

coreConflicts.systemBehavior: 按可用输入对每个 scenario 各算一次 DTA 并全部展示；缺输入的 scenario 输出 insufficient_data；显示 Manual Confirmation Required。

coreConflicts.title: 投资房 DSCR / reserve 矩阵与 45% 边界（原 CONF-006 并入）

positions.text: DSCR >= 1.2 – 6 months liquid reserve / DSCR <1.2 (or no ratio) – 12 months reserve (6 months liquid, 6 months non-liquid ok) / If LTV < 45%, cash out proceeds can be used as reserve, (if DSCR >1, no reserve needed)
45.01-50%: Min 120% DSCR + 6mo liquid | 12mo PITIA (min 6 liquid). Up to 45%: Min 100% DSCR no reserve | 6mo PITIA (min 3 liquid, remaining non-liquid or subject cash proceeds)
positions.reading: Option A/B 表格；Up to 45% 含等号

positions.text: If LTV is < 45% - no reserve if DSCR >= 1%; 6 month if DSCR is < 1%, 3 months non-liquid reserves can be from cash out proceeds, borrower need to have 3 months liquid reserves.
positions.reading: 同页文字与表格不一致；DSCR >= 1% 疑似 1.00 笔误

positions.text: C/O proceed can't be as reserves except investment DSCR for LTV<=45%
Cash out proceed can't be used as reserves.
positions.reading: 摘要页无条件禁止

coreConflicts.assessment: 需要公司给出：1.20 与 1.00 两档的 reserve 要求；45% 边界是 <45% 还是 ≤45%；『DSCR >= 1%』是否为 1.00 笔误；若 LTV 允许至 60%（CONF-001），50.01%–60% 档的 reserve 如何规定。
coreConflicts.companyQuestion: 投资房请确认：以第 22 页文字还是第 25 页表格为准；45% 边界含不含等号；DSCR >= 1% 是否应为 1.00；若投资房 LTV 可到 60%，50.01–60% 档 DSCR/reserve 要求是什么；cash-out proceeds 作 reserve 的确切条件。

tiers.optionB: 6mo (>=3 liquid, rest non-liquid or cash proceeds)

coreConflicts.systemBehavior: 两套口径各算一次；LTV 在 44.5%–45.5% 区间或结果分歧时显示 Manual Confirmation Required；『1%』原样展示并标注疑似笔误，不得由系统修正。

minorPending.title: FICO<680 时『more reserve / lower LTV』未量化
minorPending.note: 680（管理层批准）与 700（reserve 分档）是两个用途不同的门槛，本身不冲突；未决的仅是 <680 时是否在 18 个月 PITIA 之外另有加码、LTV 降到多少。另：多借款人时 FICO 取值口径未定义（AMB-008）。
minorPending.systemBehavior: FICO<680 时输出管理层批准提示 + 18 个月 reserve 计算 + 待量化备注；不阻塞判定。
